name: core-vlm-theory-v3-russian-text-candidates

candidates.decision: rejected: nearly repeated base errors; wrong descriptions of conglomerate/breccia and bioturbation
rejected: confuses conglomerate and breccia by grain size rather than rounding; misses fissility of shale; gives false carbonate mudstone distinction; weak burrow/drilling criterion

evaluation.method: qualitative, text-only, same unseen prompts and generation settings for base and adapters
evaluation.interpretation: Neither adapter showed reliable geological improvement. Seven text questions are insufficient to estimate 90-95% real-world accuracy. No photo recognition claim follows from this text-only training.

app_use_decision: Do not activate either LoRA. Use source-attributed direct answers for close matches to curated theory cards and local retrieval for other geology questions; keep visual description adapter separate.
